DCTL.description: Design Control Data (DCTL). A single record (key 1) holding global steel/concrete design control settings; FRAMEX/FRAMEY set the per-direction frame sway assumption, bAUTOKF toggles automatic effective length factor calculation, and DT selects the design dimension/plane.

FRAMEX.description: X-direction frame type. Case-insensitive. 'Braced Non-sway' = braced/non-sway frame; 'Unbraced Sway' = unbraced/sway frame.

FRAMEY.description: Y-direction frame type. Case-insensitive. 'Braced Non-sway' = braced/non-sway frame; 'Unbraced Sway' = unbraced/sway frame.

bAUTOKF.description: Automatically calculate the effective length factor (K).

DT.description: Design type / dimension. Case-insensitive. '3D' = full 3-D design; 'XZ' = X-Z plane; 'YZ' = Y-Z plane; 'XY' = X-Y plane.
